title: Shariah Compliance Monitoring
thesis: Snowflake automates Shariah compliance monitoring — AI parses contracts, indexes 200 fatwas, validates against BNM guidelines, and alerts compliance officers to non-conformance in real time

talking_points: Malaysia's Islamic finance sector manages RM 2.3 trillion in assets under Shariah governance.
Twelve financing contracts currently flagged as non-compliant — three are high-value murabahah structures.
Overall compliance rate at 98.4% — but six DSN rulings show internal conflicts.
show: Point at RM 2.3T total assets KPI
tabs.call_out: 12 contracts non-compliant — 6 DSN rulings in conflict

transition.line: Let's examine which contracts are failing and why.

talking_points: AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT extracts 47 key terms from each financing agreement automatically.
Contract #MRB-2847 flagged: profit-rate structure exceeds BNM guideline BNM/RH/PD 028-10.
ML.CLASSIFICATION scores compliance risk — 12 contracts above threshold this month.
show: Show parsed contract terms side-by-side with BNM guidelines
tabs.call_out: AI parses 47 terms per contract — validates in seconds, not days

transition.line: The contracts are validated. Let's check if the fatwas themselves are consistent.

talking_points: Two hundred fatwas indexed and searchable via Cortex Search.
Six rulings from different DSN periods show conflicting positions on commodity murabahah.
Shariah Committee can search: 'What is the latest ruling on tawarruq?' — instant retrieval.
show: Demo Cortex Search with fatwa query

transition.line: Now let the Chairman ask the system directly.

talking_points: Ustaz Dr. Mohd Nazri asks: 'Which contracts violate the latest BNM guidelines on murabahah?'
Cortex Analyst queries the compliance data — returns 3 contracts with specific clause violations.
Switch to advisory mode: 'Recommend remediation for Contract MRB-2847' — generates Shariah opinion.
show: Switch to advisory mode for remediation
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: compliance analytics + Shariah advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake, compliant with BNM standards.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, five AWS services working together.
AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT replaces Textract for contract extraction. Cortex Complete replaces Bedrock.
Malaysia's Islamic finance: RM 2.3 trillion. This monitors 5,000 contracts, 200 fatwas, 50 BNM guidelines.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native SQL, Shariah-compliant data governance

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Islamic finance compliance.
